_comment: Copy for the static Pages demo chrome and the Data sources page. English is the default markup; the Chinese strings are applied by the page script. Keep the sources in step with DATA_SOURCES.md / DATA_SOURCES.zh-CN.md (tests check the provider ids).

en.tour.title: How to read this demo
en.tour.lede: Everything here is a synthetic sample (symbols TEST1, TESTA, TESTH, TESTBTC). The pages are the same read-only views you get from your own openbars serve.
en.tour.step1: Dashboard: per-market coverage, and whether the latest session is provisional or final. Switch the interval to 1h to see an empty state: the sample has no hourly bars.
en.tour.step2: Chart: TEST1 has a provisional last bar and quality-flag markers; TEST2 is missing one session, which stays a gap instead of being filled.
en.tour.step3: Flags: every canonical bar that carries a quality flag, filterable by flag.
en.tour.step4: Data sources: which providers a self-hosted OpenBars can pull from. The demo itself pulls from none of them.
en.foot.demo: This site is a static demo built from a synthetic TEST* sample in the repository. It contacts no backend and no data provider, and it is not a hosted OpenBars service or API.
en.foot.license: Apache-2.0 licensed. Pre-alpha: interfaces may change.
en.sources.title: Data sources
en.sources.lede: Where the data comes from when you run OpenBars yourself. This demo reads no provider at all: every number in it is the synthetic TEST* sample checked into the repository.
en.sources.notice: OpenBars distributes no market data and runs no hosted fetcher. You bring your own keys, your machine does the fetching, and you must follow each provider's terms. The list below is what the code supports today; it is not an endorsement or a licence.
en.sources.sameday: Every canonical daily bar carries freshness=provisional or final. A provisional bar can appear on the day (or right after the close) and is overwritten when a later run fetches final data. The thresholds below are tier rules in the code, not provider delivery promises, and not a completeness guarantee.
en.sources.status_adapter: Adapter only, not wired into the CLI
en.sources.not: Alpha Vantage and Tiingo are not implemented and cannot be used. Anything not listed above is not supported.
en.sources.terms: Most free sources limit use to personal or internal purposes and forbid redistribution. OpenBars stores data only in your own data directory. You are responsible for reading and following each provider's terms; OpenBars is not affiliated with any provider and gives no warranty on accuracy, completeness or availability.
en.src.alpaca.access: API key ID and secret required (ALPACA_API_KEY_ID, ALPACA_API_SECRET_KEY).
en.src.alpaca.sameday: Requests for today stop at now minus 16 minutes (SIP), so a provisional bar can appear during or after the session; a later run overwrites it with the final bar. After-close availability and completeness are unverified.
en.src.alpaca.notes: Feeds sip or iex (volumes are never mixed across feeds). History from 2016-01-01. Default 200 requests/minute.
en.src.massive.sameday: Grouped daily bars are ready from 00:00 ET on the next calendar day (checked in code); earlier requests fail as retryable and are tried again later. Hourly after-close availability is unverified.
en.src.massive.notes: Daily is one request per day for the whole market; hourly sums 30-minute aggregates. Free Basic plan: about 2 years (730 days) of history, 5 requests/minute (default pacing 4).
en.src.yfinance_us.sameday: The adapter enforces no availability delay: best effort, no same-day promise. A provisional row is overwritten by a later final row.
en.src.yfinance_us.notes: Unofficial Yahoo data for personal use. Hourly covers about the last 730 days. The default 30 requests/minute is conservative pacing, not an official quota. Fills pre-2016 history and primary gaps.
en.src.twelve_data.access: API key required (TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY). Off by default.
en.src.twelve_data.sameday: No availability delay is enforced: best effort, no same-day promise.
en.src.twelve_data.notes: US 1h only, regular session only, no daily bars. Free tier: 8 requests/minute, 800 per UTC day.
en.src.binance.access: No key: public market data. Off by default.
en.src.binance.sameday: The current UTC day is provisional until 00:30 UTC the next day (tier rule). Provider timing is unverified.
en.src.binance.notes: Spot klines; the daily bar is cut at 00:00 UTC and weekends are sessions. Request weight is limited per IP. Its venue is its own instrument and is never merged with Coinbase.
en.src.coinbase.access: No key: public market data. Off by default.
en.src.coinbase.sameday: The current UTC day is provisional until 00:30 UTC the next day (tier rule). Provider timing is unverified.
en.src.coinbase.notes: Coinbase Exchange candles for BASE-QUOTE products, at most 300 candles per request, 10 requests/second per IP. Never merged with Binance.
en.src.baostock.access: No key (anonymous login). Needs openbars[baostock]. Off by default.
en.src.baostock.sameday: Final tier from 30 minutes after the close (tier rule). Provider delivery time and completeness are unverified.
en.src.baostock.notes: Unadjusted prices; adjustment factors are fetched separately for read-time qfq/hfq. Personal local use only; may be unreachable from some overseas networks.
en.src.akshare_cn.access: No key. Needs openbars[akshare]. Off by default.
en.src.akshare_cn.sameday: Final tier from 30 minutes after the close (tier rule). Provider delivery time and completeness are unverified.
en.src.akshare_cn.notes: Low-frequency backup with feed eastmoney or sina; unadjusted bars only. Enable one A-share source at a time. The AKShare library is MIT but does not relicense upstream quotes.
en.src.tushare.access: Token required (TUSHARE_TOKEN). Needs openbars[tushare]. Off by default.
en.src.tushare.sameday: Final tier from 30 minutes after the close (tier rule). Provider delivery time and completeness are unverified.
en.src.tushare.notes: Free tier (about 120 points): unadjusted daily bars only, about 50 requests/minute and 8,000/day. Personal, non-commercial licence; public use needs Tushare's attribution.
en.src.yfinance_hk.sameday: Final tier from 30 minutes after the actual close (tier rule). The adapter enforces no delay: best effort.
en.src.yfinance_hk.notes: The Hong Kong primary source: unadjusted HKD bars (hk-daily-v1), split adjustment derived at read time. Unofficial Yahoo .HK data for personal use, not a licensed HKEX feed.
en.src.akshare_hk.sameday: Not routed by plan/run, so it has no same-day behaviour of its own here.
en.src.akshare_hk.notes: Eastmoney daily bars. Its role is corroboration of the yfinance bar in the Hong Kong reconciliation; the planner never schedules it.
en.src.futu.access: A local Futu OpenD gateway that you run and log in to (default 127.0.0.1:11111). Install futu-api yourself.
en.src.futu.sameday: The planner never routes Hong Kong jobs here; same-day behaviour is unverified.
en.src.futu.notes: The adapter requests unadjusted HK daily K-lines only. A login does not imply Hong Kong quote rights; they depend on your account and Futu's terms.
en.src.longport.access: Your own LongPort account with developer verification; app key, app secret and access token come from environment variables. Install the longport SDK yourself.
en.src.longport.sameday: The planner never routes Hong Kong jobs here; same-day behaviour is unverified.
en.src.longport.notes: The adapter requests unadjusted HK daily candlesticks only. Free versus paid quote levels follow LongPort's current terms.

zh.tour.title: 怎么看这个演示
zh.tour.lede: 这里的一切都是合成样例（代码 TEST1、TESTA、TESTH、TESTBTC）。页面与你自己运行 openbars serve 得到的只读视图相同。
zh.tour.step1: 看板：按市场查看覆盖情况，以及最新交易日是 provisional 还是 final。把周期切到 1h 会看到空状态：样例里没有小时线。
zh.tour.step2: K 线：TEST1 的最后一根是 provisional，并带有质量标记；TEST2 缺了一个交易日，保持为缺口，不会被补上。
zh.tour.step3: 质量标记：所有带质量标记的规范层 K 线，可按标记筛选。
zh.tour.step4: 数据源：自托管的 OpenBars 可以从哪些渠道取数。演示站本身不从其中任何一个取数。
zh.foot.demo: 本站是由仓库内合成 TEST* 样例构建的静态演示。它不连接后端或任何数据源，也不是托管的 OpenBars 服务或 API。
zh.foot.license: Apache-2.0 许可。Pre-alpha：接口可能变化。
zh.sources.title: 数据源
zh.sources.lede: 你自己运行 OpenBars 时，数据来自哪里。本演示完全不读取任何数据源：这里的每个数字都是仓库内检入的合成 TEST* 样例。
zh.sources.notice: OpenBars 不分发行情数据，也没有托管的抓取服务。密钥由你自备，抓取在你自己的机器上完成，并且你必须遵守各数据源的条款。下表是代码目前实际支持的渠道，不代表推荐，也不构成授权。
zh.sources.sameday_title: 当日数据：先 provisional，再 final
zh.sources.sameday: 每根规范层日线都带有 freshness=provisional 或 final。provisional 可能在当天（或收盘后不久）出现，之后的运行取到 final 数据时会将其覆盖。下表是代码里的分档规则，不是数据源的交付承诺，也不保证完整。
zh.sources.not: Alpha Vantage 与 Tiingo 未实现，不能使用。上表没有列出的渠道均不受支持。
zh.sources.terms: 多数免费数据源只允许个人或内部使用，并禁止再分发。OpenBars 只把数据存放在你自己的数据目录里。你有责任阅读并遵守各数据源的条款；OpenBars 与任何数据源均无关联，也不对准确性、完整性或可用性作任何保证。
zh.sources.keys_doc: 各数据源的密钥与限额
zh.src.alpaca.access: 需要 API Key ID 与 Secret（ALPACA_API_KEY_ID、ALPACA_API_SECRET_KEY）。
zh.src.alpaca.sameday: 当天的请求截止到「当前时间减 16 分钟」（SIP），因此盘中或盘后可能出现 provisional 日线；之后的运行会用 final 覆盖。盘后可得时间与完整性未经验证。
zh.src.alpaca.notes: feed 为 sip 或 iex（不同 feed 的成交量永不混用）。历史自 2016-01-01 起。默认 200 次/分钟。
zh.src.massive.sameday: 全市场日线自次日美东 00:00 起就绪（代码已核实）；更早的请求以可重试错误失败，稍后再取。小时线盘后可得时间未经验证。
zh.src.massive.notes: 日线每天一次请求覆盖整个市场；小时线由 30 分钟聚合累加。免费 Basic 档：约 2 年（730 天）历史，5 次/分钟（默认节奏 4）。
zh.src.yfinance_us.sameday: 适配器不强制可得延迟：尽力获取，不承诺当日。provisional 行会被之后的 final 行覆盖。
zh.src.yfinance_us.notes: 非官方的 Yahoo 数据，仅限个人使用。小时线约覆盖最近 730 天。默认 30 次/分钟只是保守节奏，并非官方额度。用于补足 2016 年以前的历史和主源缺口。
zh.src.twelve_data.access: 需要 API key（TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY）。默认关闭。
zh.src.twelve_data.sameday: 不强制可得延迟：尽力获取，不承诺当日。
zh.src.twelve_data.notes: 只提供美股 1h，且只含常规时段，没有日线。免费档：8 次/分钟，每个 UTC 日 800 次。
zh.src.binance.access: 无需 key：公开行情。默认关闭。
zh.src.binance.sameday: 当前 UTC 日在次日 UTC 00:30 之前为 provisional（分档规则）。数据源的实际时效未经验证。
zh.src.binance.notes: 现货 K 线；日线以 UTC 00:00 切分，周末也是交易日。请求权重按 IP 限制。该交易所自成独立品种，不与 Coinbase 合并。
zh.src.coinbase.access: 无需 key：公开行情。默认关闭。
zh.src.coinbase.sameday: 当前 UTC 日在次日 UTC 00:30 之前为 provisional（分档规则）。数据源的实际时效未经验证。
zh.src.coinbase.notes: Coinbase Exchange 的 BASE-QUOTE 产品 K 线，每次请求最多 300 根，每 IP 10 次/秒。不与 Binance 合并。
zh.src.baostock.access: 无需 key（匿名登录）。需要 openbars[baostock]。默认关闭。
zh.src.baostock.sameday: 收盘后 30 分钟起进入 final 档（分档规则）。数据源的实际交付时间与完整性未经验证。
zh.src.baostock.notes: 不复权价格；复权因子另行获取，用于读取时的前/后复权。仅限个人本地使用；部分海外网络可能无法访问。
zh.src.akshare_cn.access: 无需 key。需要 openbars[akshare]。默认关闭。
zh.src.akshare_cn.sameday: 收盘后 30 分钟起进入 final 档（分档规则）。数据源的实际交付时间与完整性未经验证。
zh.src.akshare_cn.notes: 低频备源，feed 为 eastmoney 或 sina，只取不复权数据。一次只启用一个 A 股源。AKShare 库本身是 MIT，但不会为上游行情重新授权。
zh.src.tushare.access: 需要 token（TUSHARE_TOKEN）。需要 openbars[tushare]。默认关闭。
zh.src.tushare.sameday: 收盘后 30 分钟起进入 final 档（分档规则）。数据源的实际交付时间与完整性未经验证。
zh.src.tushare.notes: 免费档（约 120 积分）：只有不复权日线，约 50 次/分钟、每天 8000 次。个人、非商业许可；公开使用需按 Tushare 要求署名。
zh.src.yfinance_hk.sameday: 实际收盘后 30 分钟起进入 final 档（分档规则）。适配器不强制延迟：尽力获取。
zh.src.yfinance_hk.notes: 港股主源：不复权的港币日线（hk-daily-v1），拆股复权在读取时派生。非官方的 Yahoo .HK 数据，仅限个人使用，不是持牌的港交所行情。
zh.src.akshare_hk.sameday: plan/run 不会调度它，因此这里没有它自己的当日行为。
zh.src.akshare_hk.notes: 东方财富日线。它在港股合并中的作用是佐证 yfinance 的 K 线；规划器从不调度它。
zh.src.futu.access: 需要你自己运行并登录的本地 Futu OpenD 网关（默认 127.0.0.1:11111）。请自行安装 futu-api。
zh.src.futu.sameday: 规划器从不把港股任务派给它；当日行为未经验证。
zh.src.futu.notes: 适配器只请求不复权的港股日 K。登录不等于拥有港股行情权限，权限取决于你的账户与富途条款。
zh.src.longport.access: 需要你自己的 LongPort 账户并完成开发者验证；app key、app secret 与 access token 来自环境变量。请自行安装 longport SDK。
zh.src.longport.sameday: 规划器从不把港股任务派给它；当日行为未经验证。
zh.src.longport.notes: 适配器只请求不复权的港股日 K。免费与付费行情级别以 LongPort 当前条款为准。
